boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain North Central College
boards.description: Late-hour food destinations in Naperville, including several in downtown, which North Central identifies as steps from campus.

cards.title: Lou Malnati's Downtown
cards.subtitle: 131 W. Jefferson Ave., downtown Naperville
cards.notes: Use the downtown location for a pizza pickup or reservation; check the listed day before leaving because closing times vary across the week.
cards.short_summary: A downtown pizzeria with service extending to midnight on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Lou Malnati's lists its downtown Naperville pizzeria at 131 W. Jefferson Ave. and lists Friday and Saturday hours until 12:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists pizzeria hours to 12:00 a.m. Friday and Saturday; Monday–Thursday to 11:00 p.m. Confirm holiday hours before going.

cards.title: Uncle Pete's Pizza
cards.subtitle: 815 N. Washington St., Naperville
cards.notes: Plan a Friday or Saturday pizza pickup at the Washington Street shop; the official site lists midnight closing on those two nights.
cards.short_summary: A Naperville pizza shop with Friday and Saturday hours through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Uncle Pete's Pizza lists its address as 815 N. Washington St. and Friday and Saturday business hours of 4:00 p.m. to 12:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: About Us | Uncle Pete's Pizza Naperville
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 4:00 p.m.–12:00 a.m. Friday and Saturday; Sunday–Thursday close at 10:00 p.m. Check before travel.

cards.title: Portillo's on Ogden
cards.subtitle: 950 E. Ogden Ave., Naperville
cards.notes: Use the Ogden Avenue restaurant for a late pickup or drive-thru order; Friday and Saturday service is listed through midnight.
cards.short_summary: A family-friendly restaurant with drive-thru service listed until midnight on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Portillo's lists its Naperville restaurant at 950 E. Ogden Ave. and restaurant and drive-thru hours until 12:00 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists restaurant and drive-thru hours to 12:00 a.m. Friday and Saturday, and to 11:30 p.m. other days.

cards.title: Giordano's Downtown
cards.subtitle: 119 S. Main St., downtown Naperville
cards.notes: Allow for the location's posted carryout lead time when ordering; Friday and Saturday are its latest listed service nights.
cards.short_summary: A South Main Street pizza restaurant open until 11 p.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Giordano's lists its downtown Naperville location at 119 S. Main St. with Friday and Saturday hours of 10:30 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists Friday–Saturday service until 11:00 p.m.; its posted carryout lead time is 45–60 minutes.

cards.title: Chili's on Route 59
cards.subtitle: 264 S. Route 59, Naperville
cards.notes: For a later dinner, use the Route 59 location on Friday or Saturday and confirm availability through the restaurant before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A Route 59 restaurant whose published weekend hours run to 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Chili's lists its Naperville restaurant at 264 S. Route 59 and Friday and Saturday hours of 11:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists Friday and Saturday hours until 11:00 p.m.; Sunday–Thursday are listed until 10:00 p.m.

cards.title: Outback on West Ogden
cards.subtitle: 2855 W. Ogden Ave., Naperville
cards.notes: Use the West Ogden Avenue location for a Friday or Saturday dinner; verify current seating or takeaway options directly before departure.
cards.short_summary: A West Ogden Avenue restaurant listed open until 11 p.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Outback Steakhouse lists its Naperville location at 2855 W. Ogden Ave. and Friday and Saturday hours of 11:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Outback Steakhouse Naperville off West Ogden Avenue
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists Friday and Saturday hours until 11:00 p.m.; other listed closing times are earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on East Ogden
cards.subtitle: 1019 E. Ogden Ave., Naperville
cards.notes: For the latest listed option, use the drive-thru at East Ogden; its dine-in schedule is earlier, so check the service type first.
cards.short_summary: A drive-thru location listed as late as 4 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists its 1019 East Ogden location's drive-thru open until 4:00 a.m. Friday and Saturday and until 3:00 a.m. other days.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Naperville, IL – 1019 East Ogden
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru hours to 4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday and 3:00 a.m. other days. Dine-in closes earlier; verify before arriving.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Aurora Avenue
cards.subtitle: 2775 Aurora Ave., Naperville
cards.notes: This Aurora Avenue location has the same listed 3 a.m. close daily for drive-thru and dine-in; confirm service availability before travel.
cards.short_summary: A Naperville Taco Bell with official daily hours through 3 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists its 2775 Aurora Ave. location's drive-thru and dine-in hours as 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 a.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Naperville, IL – 2775 Aurora Ave.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists both drive-thru and dine-in to 3:00 a.m. daily. Confirm holiday or temporary changes before going.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Rickert Drive
cards.subtitle: 1287 Rickert Dr., Naperville
cards.notes: Use drive-thru when arriving after the dining room's listed close; Thursday through Saturday have the latest posted drive-thru hours.
cards.short_summary: A Rickert Drive location with drive-thru service listed through 3 a.m. Thursday through Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists its 1287 Rickert Dr. drive-thru open until 3:00 a.m. Thursday through Saturday and until 2:00 a.m. Sunday through Wednesday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Naperville, IL – 1287 Rickert Dr.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru hours to 3:00 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; dine-in hours are earlier. Verify the current service mode before going.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Reflection Drive
cards.subtitle: 3028 Reflection Drive, Naperville
cards.notes: Make this a drive-thru pickup on Friday or Saturday for the latest listed closing time; dining room service ends earlier.
cards.short_summary: A Reflection Drive drive-thru listed until 2 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists its 3028 Reflection Drive drive-thru open until 2:00 a.m. Friday and Saturday and until 1:00 a.m. Sunday through Thursday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Naperville, IL – 3028 Reflection Drive
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru to 2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday and 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday; dine-in is listed only to 10:00 p.m.
